The University of California, Office of the President, is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience. The full salary range shows the growth potential for this position and the pay scale is the budgeted salary or hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position.

Demonstrated ability to produce polished, executive-ready reports, presentations, dashboards, and other decision-support materials; strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. $118,000 to $135,000, Commensurate with Experience

The Project & Operations Analyst supports the planning and delivery of UCOP Operations projects and recurring programs under the direction of the UCOP Operations Immediate Office. Reporting to the Deputy, this hands-on role combines project management and coordination with analysis, reporting, process improvement, digital tools, and communications support. The analyst keeps work moving through strong planning and follow-through, analyzes information and produces polished reports and presentations, improves workflows using technology, and develops clear communications for varied stakeholders. The role requires someone comfortable shifting between detailed coordination and independent ownership of defined work.  Please note this is a hybrid position with three days a week in Oakland, CA.
35% Project Management & Coordination
Plan and coordinate cross-functional projects and programs, maintaining timelines, milestones, action items, documentation, dependencies, risks, and status reporting.
Organize project meetings and materials, document decisions and next steps, and ensure timely stakeholder follow-through.
Independently manage defined projects or workstreams while providing hands-on coordination and administrative support for broader initiatives.
25% Analysis, Reporting & Decision Support
Gather, validate, and analyze information from multiple sources to identify trends, gaps, and issues requiring follow-up.
Develop metrics, dashboards, reports, presentations, and briefings that translate complex information into clear findings and practical recommendations.
Conduct research and operational analysis to support project, program, and leadership decision-making.
25% Process Improvement & Digital Tools
Assess workflows and processes, identify root causes and inefficiencies, and implement practical improvements using process improvement methods as appropriate.

Develop forms, templates, standard work, and workflows, and use tools such as Smartsheet, SharePoint, Power BI, Microsoft 365, and generative AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and visibility.
15% Communications & Implementation Support
Draft and edit project updates, leadership and staff communications, presentations, and other stakeholder materials.
Support implementation and adoption of projects, processes, and tools through clear communications, job aids, training materials, and related resources as needed.
Affinity for using Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT, CoPilot, etc.
10% Occasional travel to campus locations and/or conferences.
Organizational Consultant 3
Benefits: For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University visit: Benefits of Belonging
Project Management & Coordination Skills:
Analytical, Reporting & Process Improvement Skills:

Strong project planning, coordination, and implementation skills, including the ability to manage plans, timelines, documentation, stakeholder follow-up, and multiple competing priorities. Demonstrated ability to shift between independent ownership of defined work and detailed coordination or administrative execution, with strong attention to detail, initiative, and reliable follow-through.
Communication, Consulting & Relationship Skills:

Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, draft clear communications for varied audiences, and facilitate productive stakeholder interactions. Strong service orientation, sound judgment, and the ability to build effective working relationships in a complex, matrixed environment.
Technical & Digital Skills:
Digital fluency and demonstrated ability to learn and apply tools such as Smartsheet, SharePoint, Power BI, Microsoft 365, generative AI, or comparable platforms to improve work.
